title: Understanding Angular Momentum
text: Angular momentum $$L$$ for a rolling object is given by the formula $$L=I\omega$$, $$where$$ $$I$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$moment$$ $$of$$ $$inertia$$ $$and$$ $$\omega$$ is the angular velocity.

title: Moment of Inertia for a Sphere
text: The moment of inertia $$I$$ for a uniform solid sphere is $$I=(2/5)mr**{2}$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$this$$ $$to$$ $$calculate$$ $$I$$ $$for$$ $$the$$ $$boulder$$.

title: Relating Linear and Angular Velocity
text: The angular velocity $$\omega$$ can be found using the relationship $$\omega=\frac{v}{r}$$, $$where$$ $$v$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$linear$$ $$velocity$$ $$and$$ $$r$$ is the radius of the sphere.

title: Finding Linear Velocity
text: Use energy conservation to find the linear velocity $$v$$ at the bottom of the hill. The potential energy at the top is converted to kinetic energy at the bottom.

title: Calculate Moment of Inertia
text: Calculate the moment of inertia $$I$$ for the boulder using $$I=(2/5)mr**{2}$$, $$where$$ $$\, \text{m}\$\$=20$$ kg and $$r=0.2\, \text{m}$$.
